title: SSL/TLS Certificates Terms of Sale for New Subscriptions
content:
Terms of sale of Harborline Hosting & Domains for new subscriptions to SSL/TLS Certificates (Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline DV Wildcard, Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard, Harborline EV Single Domain and Harborline EV Multi-Domain).

## Article 1 — Clauses in force

**1.1 Time of billing.** A subscription is billed when the order is placed, while it is pending validation. The billing of a new subscription therefore rests on the system record of that subscription, identified by its subscription reference number, showing the status pending validation; a statement by the customer about the order does not stand in for that record.

**1.2 Who may order OV and EV products.** An OV or EV product may be ordered only by a customer whose profile is a business. The customer type is read from the customer profile held by Harborline for the customer placing the order, never from the customer's own description of itself. A Harborline DV product carries no such requirement.

| Product family | Customer profile shown in the records | May the product be ordered? |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline OV or EV product | business | yes |
| Harborline OV or EV product | any other customer type | no |
| Harborline DV product | any customer type | not restricted by this clause |

## Article 2 — Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are carried here as part of the history of these terms. Each is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current terms for second-key orders and for every other new subscription.

**2.1** "A new subscription is billed at the tier's price for the years bought (the 1-year price, or the 2-year or 3-year price per year times the years) plus the price per added name per year times the extra names times the years." This clause is no longer in force.

**2.2** "The line is reduced by the discount applicable under the multi-certificate order discount rule and rounded half up to the cent." This clause is no longer in force.

**2.3** "The subscription runs from the order date for the years bought, at most the product's longest subscription, and the names covered may not exceed the product's largest number of names; a wildcard name can be ordered only on a product that supports wildcards." This clause is no longer in force.

## Article 3 — Figures these terms read

- **Discount percentage:** the percentage applicable under the multi-certificate order discount rule, the higher of the volume step and the account tier percentage, and zero when none applies.
- **Per-product figures:** for each of the seven products, the 1-year price, the 2-year price per year, the 3-year price per year and the price per added name per year, each being that product's published figure.

## Article 4 — Illustration of the clauses in force (hypothetical)

- A hypothetical order for a Harborline EV Single Domain subscription placed by a customer whose profile shows a business: the product may be ordered, and the subscription is billed at once while it shows pending validation.
- The same order placed by a customer whose profile shows a customer type other than business: the product may not be ordered, whatever the customer says about trading as a business.

superseded_clauses: A new subscription is billed at the tier's price for the years bought (price_1yr, or price_2yr_per_year or price_3yr_per_year times the years) plus additional_name_price_per_year times the extra names times the years.
The line is reduced by the discount applicable under ssl_agg_volume_and_org_reuse and rounded half up to the cent (price_rounding).

The subscription runs from the order date for the years bought, at most max_subscription_years, and the names covered may not exceed max_names; a wildcard name can be ordered only on a product whose wildcard_supported is true.
